description: Purpose of this region: shared working notes that are meant to be temporary — intermediate results, handovers, anything in flight.
content:
This region is deliberately transient.

Belongs here: intermediate findings, notes another accessor may need before you are done, anything worth writing down but not worth keeping.

Does not belong here: anything that should still be true next month. Move it to the region it belongs to before it fades.

Two things are different here. Every general agent holds operator rights, so anyone may edit or delete anything — tidying up is expected, not an intrusion. And nothing is protected from expiry: an unrated entry disappears after roughly three months without a write and six weeks without a read. That is the point of the region, not a defect.
